notes: This was a spike on how to read the whole itinerary of a long trip, since a 14-day read was too big for Claude Code's tool result limit. The body started at 890 words, was 1,194 when PR #140 opened, and ended at 1,763 after 10 versions. Most of the growth came on 2026-10-26, after the PR opened. Six open questions were added and struck the same day with their answers (I129-15 to I129-22), and Do and Done when were written at 17:06, two minutes before the PR merged. Settled questions are half the words, and a section of #54's measurements (I129-4 to I129-13) is another 29%, as result. The answers under the struck questions are part of the remaining task, not history: they are the agreed design that the next session writes into the docs (I129-25), though several only rule out options (I129-17, I129-18, I129-19). The PR was a research doc, not code, so its description (P140-d0) is task text written fresh, not copied, since the issue had no Do yet. The decisions comment holds one real decision (P140-c1, not written into a design doc), a note that the issue body was fixed (P140-c2), and a forecast of the proposal (P140-c3). That forecast named version F at 17,546 tokens, but the settled read in I129-14 is 15,291, so the comment went out of date. Results went into the body (the #54 section and I129-14) and the research doc. Status went into struck Do items and done marks in Done when (I129-23, I129-24, I129-26).
